Convoy

Jun 25, 1985Suddenly, things have got a lot more interesting out here. I get this urgent call from HQ, and it turns out they’re reassigning me from Blackhawk transport to a Cobra gunship! They just don’t have enough pilots to go round. Everon’s a fairly flat island, making it ideal for air-to-ground attacks. And with a full Cobra arsenal at my command, I’m gonna wreak havoc out there!

First up, there’s a Russian convoy en route to Le Moule from Morton, carrying fresh soldiers and a lot of ammo. Following heavy fighting, our infantry have had to retreat from Le Moule, but the enemy there is now weak and without ammunition. If I can take down this convoy, they’ll be cut off and vulnerable to a renewed assault once we can re-group our troops.

Anyway, I’d better locate that jeep – we’ve got to get the helipad as quickly as possible.
